references.role: character identity reference and redesign target: original slender judicial statue, wavy hair, blindfold, star robe, greatsword and balance
hard transformation magnitude and credible deployed mechanical hinges only; no gargoyle anatomy or bulk copied
hinged face-shell opening and exposed clockwork construction only; no extra body arms or puppeteer identity copied

visual_qa.identity: Normal swept ivory curls and blindfold/lower face remain recognizable; slender feminine figure, navy high collar, gold stars, long ceremonial coat and original sword family retained.
visual_qa.hard_difference: Original rear beam develops into two massive articulated weapon arms. Exactly two scale bowls become giant crescent-rimmed pincers with taut chain actuators. Open flank exposes brass spine and piston linkages; cracked cheek and torn coat reinforce hard form.
visual_qa.anatomy: Two actual body arms with two hands hold one sword, two human-shaped legs/feet. Two separate back-mounted mechanical weapon supports terminate in two pan-pincers.
visual_qa.framing: Full broad deployed mechanism, both weapon-pans, sword point, curls, coat and both feet are inside canvas; upper and lower margins are narrow but uncut.
visual_qa.style: Clean polished ivory/navy/brass game concept, pale lavender background, single full-body hero, no text/insets/gore/photorealism.

limits: Single-view generated concept, not 3D mesh or rig validation. Earlier concepts remain unchanged. No framing correction was generated because all extremities are contained.
